name: AtlaSentGate
description: Enforce a real-time AtlaSent authorization gate before a deployment or other critical pipeline step runs (evaluate -> verify -> permit, fail-closed); for Azure deployments, admit and close a Consequential Operation from Azure's own Activity Log
helpMarkDown: See https://github.com/Atlasent/atlasent-action/tree/main/packages/azure-devops-task for the full input/output reference and pipeline examples. Requires the ATLASENT_API_KEY secret and (optionally) ATLASENT_BASE_URL to be set as environment variables on this task step.
author: AtlaSent Systems, Inc.

inputs.name: action
inputs.label: Protected action type
inputs.helpMarkDown: The protected action being evaluated (e.g. production.deploy, package.release). Must be a well-known AtlaSent action type — the AtlaSent runtime policy is the authority on whether it is allowed. Also required in verifyPermit mode, so the boundary re-verification presents the same action type the permit was issued for.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.label: Mode

options.enforce: enforce (evaluate + verify + consume in one step; not allowed for an Azure scope)
options.evaluate-only: evaluate-only (issue a permit without consuming it)
options.admit-operation: admit-operation (Azure: consume the permit and admit an operation, before the deployment)
options.establish-effect: establish-effect (Azure: verify the deployment in the Activity Log and close the operation)

inputs.helpMarkDown: 'enforce' (default) performs evaluate -> verify -> verify-permit in this task step. 'evaluate-only' issues a permit WITHOUT consuming it. For an Azure deployment (azureSubscriptionId/azureResourceGroup given) the path is: 'evaluate-only', then 'admit-operation' immediately before the deployment (consumes the permit and admits a Consequential Operation in one runtime transaction; run the deployment only if this step succeeds), then 'establish-effect' after it (AtlaSent reads Azure's Activity Log for the deployment's correlation id and the runtime closes the operation only from that evidence). 'enforce' and verifyPermit are refused for an Azure scope. Ignored when verifyPermit is 'true'.

inputs.name: verifyPermit
inputs.label: Verify permit (execution boundary)
inputs.helpMarkDown: When true, this task step does NOT call evaluate at all — it re-verifies (and consumes) an already-issued permit token immediately before a protected step, independent of the step that issued it. Requires permitToken, and the same action/actor/environment/targetId the permit was issued for. Not allowed for an Azure-scoped step: use mode admit-operation instead, so the deployment is recorded as a Consequential Operation.

inputs.name: permitToken
inputs.label: Permit token to verify
inputs.helpMarkDown: Required when verifyPermit is 'true' or mode is 'admit-operation': the permitToken output from an earlier mode: evaluate-only task step.

inputs.name: actor
inputs.label: Actor
inputs.helpMarkDown: Triggering identity. Defaults to Build.RequestedFor (or Release.RequestedFor on a classic release pipeline) when left blank, then falls back to 'unknown'.

inputs.name: targetId
inputs.label: Target ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: Target resource identifier (service name, artifact id, etc.). Re-presented at a later verify-permit boundary if you split evaluate and verify across stages.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.label: Environment
inputs.helpMarkDown: Deployment environment passed to the evaluator. When left blank, it is inferred from the ATLASENT_API_KEY prefix (ask_test_/ask_live_) or, failing that, from Build.SourceBranch (main/master => live, otherwise test).

inputs.name: azureSubscriptionId
inputs.label: Azure subscription ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: The Azure subscription this step will change. Give it together with azureResourceGroup. It is signed into the permit, so the same values must be given again on the verifyPermit step, and AtlaSent can later verify the change against Azure's Activity Log.

inputs.name: azureResourceGroup
inputs.label: Azure resource group
inputs.helpMarkDown: The resource group this step will change. Must be one of the production resource groups selected on the org's Azure connection for the Activity Log check to apply.

inputs.name: azureDeploymentName
inputs.label: Azure deployment name
inputs.helpMarkDown: The ARM deployment name this step will use (az deployment group create --name). Requires azureSubscriptionId and azureResourceGroup. Required for mode admit-operation: AtlaSent stores it with the decision, and only that deployment can later establish the decision's effect from Azure's Activity Log.

inputs.name: executionHash
inputs.label: Execution hash
inputs.helpMarkDown: Required for mode admit-operation: the executionHash output of the evaluate-only step (the payload binding the runtime put in the permit). Pass it unchanged.

inputs.name: operationId
inputs.label: Operation ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: Required for mode establish-effect: the operationId output of the admit-operation step.

inputs.name: attemptId
inputs.label: Attempt ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: Required for mode establish-effect: the attemptId output of the admit-operation step.

inputs.name: evaluationId
inputs.label: Evaluation ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: Required for mode establish-effect when the deployment succeeded: the evaluationId output of the evaluate-only step.

inputs.name: correlationId
inputs.label: Deployment correlation ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: Required for mode establish-effect when the deployment succeeded: the ARM deployment's correlation id (az deployment group create ... --query properties.correlationId -o tsv).

inputs.name: deploymentOutcome
inputs.label: Deployment outcome
inputs.helpMarkDown: For mode establish-effect: 'succeeded', 'failed' or 'unknown' (Agent.JobStatus values are accepted). Anything but succeeded is recorded on the attempt as failure/unknown and fails this step; it never establishes an effect.

inputs.name: effectWaitMinutes
inputs.label: Effect wait minutes
inputs.helpMarkDown: For mode establish-effect: how long to keep asking while Azure's Activity Log has not yet surfaced the deployment (max 120). Exceeding it fails closed.

inputs.name: context
inputs.label: Context (JSON)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional JSON object of additional context passed to the evaluator (e.g. {"service": "api"}).

inputs.name: approvalsFrom
inputs.label: Approvals from

options.pr-reviews: pr-reviews (not yet implemented for Azure DevOps)

inputs.helpMarkDown: Source for context.approvals. 'pr-reviews' is not yet implemented for Azure DevOps Pipelines in this v1 task (Azure Repos pull request reviews are not auto-derived) — it is accepted for forward compatibility with the GitHub Action's input surface but is treated as 'none' with a logged warning. Pass context.approvals explicitly if your policy requires an approval count.

inputs.name: waitForApproval
inputs.label: Wait for approval
inputs.helpMarkDown: When true, a hold/escalate decision pauses and polls for a human resolution (bounded by maxWaitMinutes) instead of failing the step immediately.

inputs.name: maxWaitMinutes
inputs.label: Max wait minutes
inputs.helpMarkDown: Bound on waitForApproval's poll window, in minutes. Exceeding it fails closed.

inputs.name: apiUrl
inputs.label: AtlaSent API URL override
inputs.helpMarkDown: Overrides the ATLASENT_BASE_URL environment variable, e.g. https://<project-ref>.supabase.co/functions/v1. Usually left blank in favor of the environment variable.

outputVariables.name: decision
outputVariables.description: The evaluation decision: allow / deny / hold / escalate.

outputVariables.name: verified
outputVariables.description: "true" only when decision=allow AND the permit was verified. Gate on this, not decision.

outputVariables.name: permitToken
outputVariables.description: The permit token (already consumed by verify-permit) — audit reference only.

outputVariables.name: riskScore
outputVariables.description: Numeric risk score 0-100; empty string when not assessed.

outputVariables.name: evaluationId
outputVariables.description: Unique evaluation ID for the audit trail.

outputVariables.name: waitedForApproval
outputVariables.description: "true" when a hold/escalate decision was paused and waited on for a human resolution.

outputVariables.name: executionHash
outputVariables.description: The payload binding the runtime put in the permit (evaluate-only). Pass it to mode admit-operation.

outputVariables.name: operationId
outputVariables.description: admit-operation: the admitted Consequential Operation id.

outputVariables.name: operationKey
outputVariables.description: admit-operation: the idempotency key (a digest of the permit) to look the operation up by.

outputVariables.name: admissionOutcomeUnknown
outputVariables.description: "true" when admission may have committed with the response lost. Do not deploy and do not mint a fresh permit; look the operation up first.

outputVariables.name: azureObservationId
outputVariables.description: establish-effect: the Activity Log observation AtlaSent recorded.

outputVariables.name: effectState
outputVariables.description: establish-effect: the operation state the runtime reported.

outputVariables.name: effectEstablished
outputVariables.description: "true" only when the runtime established the deployment's effect.
